user.title: Home Keeper — Bambu Lab
user.description: Surface a Bambu Lab printer's firmware update as a Home Keeper task, so a pending update shows up in your to-do list. The task clears itself once the printer's firmware is up to date. Requires both Home Keeper and the Bambu Lab integration.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is needed.

data_description.name_template: Name for each printer's firmware task. Use the word printer_name in braces as a placeholder for the printer's name — as shown in the default.
data_description.maintenance: Create Home Keeper tasks for Bambu Lab's published maintenance schedule — lead-screw greasing, rod cleaning, the air filter and so on. The ones measured in printer hours are metered against the printer's usage-hours sensor, with a calendar backstop so an idle printer still comes due. Turn it on to choose which items you want on the next screen.

select_printer.title: Choose a printer
select_printer.description: Bambu Lab publishes a different schedule for each printer series, so your printers are set up one at a time. Pick one to configure and you will come back here afterwards for the next. Choose Save and finish when you are done.

model.title: Printer model
model.description: Setting up {printer_name}. Detected model: {detected}. The model decides which maintenance items start switched on and what their intervals are pre-filled with. Nothing else depends on it, so pick another series if the detection is wrong, or Other if your printer is not listed.

data_description.model: Pre-filled with what we read from the printer. Other leaves only the items every Bambu Lab printer has switched on, and you tick the rest yourself on the next screen.

items.title: Printer maintenance
items.description: Bambu Lab's maintenance schedule for {printer_name}, one task per item. Defaults come from the {model} schedule. Every item is listed, whatever the printer, so you can add one we did not tick. Intervals are pre-filled with the manufacturer's figures. Change any of them, or turn an item off. You can also retune an interval later on the task itself.

data.item_linear_rods_enabled: Clean and oil the linear rods
data.item_linear_rods_interval: Clean and oil the linear rods — every
data.item_z_lead_screws_interval: Grease the Z-axis lead screws — every
data.item_carbon_filter_enabled: Replace the activated carbon air filter
data.item_carbon_filter_interval: Replace the activated carbon air filter — every
data.item_carbon_rods_interval: Clean the X-axis carbon rods — every
data.item_rod_antirust_enabled: Anti-rust treatment on the Y/Z rods
data.item_rod_antirust_interval: Anti-rust treatment on the Y/Z rods — every
data.item_extruder_gear_enabled: Check and clean the extruder gear
data.item_extruder_gear_interval: Check and clean the extruder gear — every
data.item_toolhead_fans_enabled: Check and clean the toolhead fans
data.item_toolhead_fans_interval: Check and clean the toolhead fans — every

data_description.item_linear_rods_interval: About 150 printer hours, which is Bambu Lab's monthly check at five hours a day. A monthly calendar backstop applies as well, whichever lands first.
data_description.item_z_lead_screws_interval: About 450 printer hours, which is Bambu Lab's quarterly service at five hours a day. A quarterly calendar backstop applies as well, whichever lands first.
data_description.item_carbon_filter_interval: About 720 printer hours, which is Bambu Lab's three months of eight-hour days. A quarterly calendar backstop applies as well, whichever lands first.
data_description.item_carbon_rods_interval: Bambu Lab suggests monthly. Only the X1 and P1 series use carbon rods on the X axis.
data_description.item_rod_antirust_interval: Bambu Lab suggests quarterly, on the X1 and P1 series.
data_description.item_camera_lens_interval: Bambu Lab suggests every six months. The A1 series ships without a camera.
data_description.item_extruder_gear_interval: Bambu Lab suggests weekly. Off by default on every model, because weekly is a lot of reminders unless the printer runs most days.
data_description.item_toolhead_fans_interval: Bambu Lab suggests weekly, and it is off by default for the same reason as the extruder gear check.
